summary: Gilat Satellite Networks filed a 6-K announcing a private placement of convertible notes to Israeli institutional investors, expected to close September 1, 2026. The notes raise approximately $100 million gross, bearing 3.75% annual interest, maturing September 1, 2031, convertible initially at $16.00 per share, a 60% premium over the August 28, 2026 closing price of $9.94. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, especially next-gen satellite and defense investments. The placement is Regulation S only, not offered in the U.S. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation; no deal terms beyond note characteristics are provided.
